verdict.rationale: Oneleet has RBAC/org roles, MDM device management including remote offboarding actions, and policy publishing, which touch pieces of onboarding/offboarding compliance, but there is no evidence of an HR-system sync, a dedicated onboarding/offboarding checklist workflow, or training-completion tracking tied to hires/leavers. missing for 10: HR system integration/sync, explicit onboarding/offboarding checklist feature, training assignment and completion tracking, audit trail proving access removal tied to termination events.
